title: Independently inspect selected Math Discovery skill metadata without canonical source input
commitMessage: test: qualify isolated Discovery skill metadata consumer

contribution.summary: Add a read-only, bundle-root-only Math Discovery metadata consumer with four deliberate refusal cases.
contribution.value: Consume only skill files to verify four selected method IDs and SHA-256 fingerprints, two package identities, navigation, runtime-only authorization and zero BrokerReady; reject selection and authority drift without relying on the canonical source manifest.
debtChanges: RS210 succeeded attempt 001 first-pass true; Discovery README now separates current qualification from historic planning.
RS211 checks self-contained skill metadata inspectability; it does not claim independent NuGet installation, executable provider routing or AURA adoption.
M8 remains not-ready. Immutable private packages, existing source evidence and broker boundary are unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: Assess whether an isolated packaged consumer of the accepted skill delivery is required and reconcile native DWF readiness with the accepted M8 tasks.
